title: How Many Fish to BEAT Stockfish?
summary: Tony has a king plus N Fish (move like a king + knight, 'flopping radius') vs Stockfish's army WITHOUT its queen, adding one fish per game. Single fish games are hopeless; he keeps adding fish and wins with six fish.
rules: Player: king + N Fish (N starts at 1, +1 each loss). Opponent: Fairy-Stockfish's full army minus the queen.
Fish moves like a king OR a knight (centaur/crowned-knight: 1 step any direction or (2,1) leap).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish (won with 6 fish per rules digest).

board.theme_notes: blue-grey/white board, green arrows for fish moves

setup: Black: rnb1kbnr/pppppppp (no queen). White: Ke1 + N fish (first fish developed to e3 on move 1).
current_impl_issues: Impl 'howmany' gives extra KNIGHTS (n=4) with a full army; video is king + fish (king+knight compound) vs queenless army, starting at 1 and adding per loss.
evidence: Own srt: 00:01 'fish moves like a king and a knight and I will add one extra fish each game. I've also taken Fishy's queen'; 00:22 fish to e3; 11:22 (Amazons video) recalls 'win with like five fish or whatever'. rules.jsonl: won with six fish. Frame visual_a; sprites fish_piece.
